{{Top|leg}}
'''Tharak''' was a continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fyodos]]. During the [[Great Cleansing]], ninety percent of Tharak's population was wiped out. By [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], it was the only continent to support a [[Human/Legends|Human]] population, divided into feudal tribes.
